notes: GOD 3.0 adds a native Sora/TextMate editor, expandable file tree, find/replace, project search and an optional ARM64 Debian PRoot shell; type exit to return to the app. Only the 0.4.20 trail lane/ribbon drawing algorithm is reverted to rounded polylines. Route preferences, labels and Resonations audio remain. New APK signing identity requires a one-time backup, uninstall, install and restore; uninstalling without an externally exported backup loses private app data. 132 tests, lint and app/module builds passed; physical-device shell/editor and restore validation remain pending.
